about.title: About Me
about.subtitle: I turn data into decisions and goals into results.
about.bio: I started working in 2006 as a technician. I went on to teach AutoCAD as a master instructor, and in 2012 I founded my own company, which I ran for nearly six years. Since 2019 I have worked as a data analyst at SASA Polyester, turning raw data into clear reports that people can act on.
about.bio_more: I work independently, set a clear goal and stay with it until it is done; that is where my stubborn streak comes from. I am not at ease until I understand a system from end to end, and I enjoy sharing what I learn with the people around me.
about.portrait_alt: Black-and-white portrait of Mustafa Ali Solmazgül
about.meta_description: My experience, skills and education in data analytics, reporting, computer systems and AutoCAD.
